name: cavemio-copy-button
title: Copy button
description: Copies on the press: the icon blurs into a self-drawing check, the label morphs to Copied, and a failed copy shakes and says so.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Uses navigator.clipboard, with a selection fallback for older browsers and plain-http pages.
- The copied state is optimistic: it shows on the press, not after the clipboard promise.
- Reduced motion: icons and labels change in place, no shake.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: label
props.description: "Copy" · Label while idle; also the icon-only button's accessible name.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: false · Show the label beside the icon.

props.name: timeoutMs
props.description: 2000 · How long the copied state stays.

useCases.title: Code blocks
useCases.description: Top-right copy button in syntax-highlighted code specimens.

useCases.title: Share links & invite codes
useCases.description: One-tap copy for URLs and referral tokens.

useCases.title: API keys & secrets
useCases.description: Fast copying of sensitive tokens with visual confirmation.

features.title: Checkmark morph
features.description: The copy icon crossfades smoothly into a green checkmark on successful copy.

features.title: Instant feedback
features.description: The copied state lands on the press itself; the clipboard write catches up, and if it is refused the button says Failed and shakes.

features.title: Label morph
features.description: Icon only, or labelled: "Copy" morphs into "Copied" through TextMorph and the pill eases to its new width.

features.title: Self-reverting timer
features.description: Returns to idle after timeoutMs (2000ms); pressing again while copied copies again and restarts it.

features.title: Accessible announcement
features.description: A status region outside the button announces "Copied" (or "Failed"); the icon-only button keeps "Copy" as its name.

states.title: idle
states.description: The copy icon, and "Copy" when labelled.

states.title: copied
states.description: On the press: the icon blurs out (scale 0.6, 3px) while an emerald check draws itself in 360ms; the label morphs to "Copied" and the pill eases wider. Back to idle after 2s.

states.title: error
states.description: If the clipboard refuses: red tint, an alert icon, "Failed" and a 380ms shake.
